title: Part
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch which consists of six faces. On the first face, draw ten lines forming a complex shape starting from the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ending back at the origin. The second face involves drawing four lines to create a small rectangular section near the bottom left corner. The third face has another set of four lines, forming a similar rectangular section but positioned higher up. The fourth face repeats this pattern, creating another small rectangular section further up. The fifth face creates a small rectangular section near the top. Finally, the sixth face completes the outline by drawing ten lines forming a larger, more complex shape on the right side. After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire 2D sketch. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into a three-dimensional model by rotating it using the same Euler angles and translating it with the same vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0125 units in the direction of the normal to generate the 3D model, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. This extrusion will create a new solid body with the final dimensions of length 0.26, width 0.75, and height 0.0125.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the outer rectangle
r = r.box(0.26, 0.75, 0.0125, centered=(False, False, False))

# Define the inner rectangles
inner_rectangles = [
    (0.0125, 0.0125, 0.235, 0.235),
    (0.0125, 0.2625, 0.235, 0.235),
    (0.0125, 0.5125, 0.235, 0.235),
    (0.0125, 0.7475, 0.235, 0.235)
]

# Cut the inner rectangles from the outer rectangle
for x, y, width, height in inner_rectangles:
    r = r.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(x, y).box(width, height, 0.0125, centered=(False, False, False)))

# Final model
r = r

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Outer frame dimensions
L = 0.26   # X
W = 0.75   # Y
T = 0.0125 # Z (thickness)
t = 0.01   # wall thickness

# Build the ladder frame: outer rectangle with three rectangular cutouts
frame = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(L, W, centered=False)
    .extrude(T)
)

# Cut three inner rectangular openings
cut1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(t, t)
    .lineTo(L - t, t)
    .lineTo(L - t, W / 3 - 0.006)
    .lineTo(t, W / 3 - 0.006)
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)

cut2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(t, W / 3 + 0.006)
    .lineTo(L - t, W / 3 + 0.006)
    .lineTo(L - t, 2 * W / 3 - 0.006)
    .lineTo(t, 2 * W / 3 - 0.006)
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)

cut3 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(t, 2 * W / 3 + 0.006)
    .lineTo(L - t, 2 * W / 3 + 0.006)
    .lineTo(L - t, W - t)
    .lineTo(t, W - t)
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)

r = frame.cut(cut1).cut(cut2).cut(cut3)
